test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which new index, presented in March 2025 by the International Finance Forum, evaluates global AI competitiveness?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)** is a **central sector scheme** designed to provide **social security** and **old age protection** specifically for **unorganized workers**.
 
• The scheme was officially launched on **5 March 2019** by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** at **Vastral, Gujarat**. It targets the massive workforce in the informal sector, which accounts for nearly **42 crore** workers in India.
 
• It was first announced during the **Interim Budget 2019-20**, which was presented in the **Parliament** by the then Union Minister for Finance, **Shri Piyush Goyal**, on **1 February 2019**.
 
• The **eligibility criteria** for the scheme mandate that the beneficiary must be an **unorganized worker** within the **entry age** group of **18 to 40 years**.
 
• Subscribers must have a **monthly income** of **Rs. 15,000 or less** and should not be covered under other social security frameworks like **EPFO**, **ESIC**, or the **National Pension System (NPS)**, nor should they be **income taxpayers**.
 
• The scheme is implemented through the **Life Insurance Corporation (LIC)** of India, which acts as the **Fund Manager** and is responsible for the **pension pay-out**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY):**
 
 
• This is the **world’s largest health assurance scheme**, launched in **September 2018** to provide a health cover of **Rs. 5 lakhs** per family per year.
 
• It focuses on **secondary and tertiary care** hospitalization for the bottom **40%** of the Indian population, covering over **12 crore** vulnerable families.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY):**
 
 
• Launched on **9 May 2015**, this is an **accident insurance scheme** available to people in the age group of **18 to 70 years**.
 
• It provides a cover of **Rs. 2 lakh** for **accidental death** or **total disability** and **Rs. 1 lakh** for **partial disability** at a very low annual premium, which was recently revised to **Rs. 20**.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY):**
 
 
• This is a **one-year life insurance scheme**, renewable from year to year, offering coverage for **death** due to any reason.
 
• It is available to individuals in the age group of **18 to 50 years** having a **bank account**. The annual premium is **Rs. 436** for a life cover of **Rs. 2 lakh**.
 
 
 
• **Atal Pension Yojana (APY):**
 
 
• Another pension scheme launched in **2015**, primarily targeting the **unorganized sector**, where the **pension amount** varies from **Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000** based on the **contribution** and **age of joining**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Pension Benefit:** Under **PM-SYM**, after attaining the **age of 60 years**, the beneficiary is entitled to receive a **minimum assured monthly pension** of **Rs. 3,000**.
 
• **Matching Contribution:** It is a **voluntary and contributory** scheme where the **Government of India** makes a **50% matching contribution**. For instance, if a worker contributes **Rs. 100**, the Central Government also deposits **Rs. 100** into the pension account.
 
• **Family Pension:** During the receipt of the pension, if the subscriber **dies**, the **spouse** of the beneficiary shall be entitled to receive **50%** of the pension received by such beneficiary as **family pension**.
 
• **Contribution Amount:** The monthly contribution ranges from **Rs. 55 to Rs. 200**, depending on the **entry age** of the subscriber. A person joining at **18 years** pays the minimum, while one joining at **40 years** pays the maximum.
 
• **Enrollment:** The registration is facilitated through **Common Service Centers (CSCs)** located across the **country**, making it accessible to rural and urban **unorganized laborers** alike.
